verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships an official `gz` command-line tool. The docs show `gz sim shapes.sdf` launching a simulation, `-s` for headless server-only runs, `-g` for GUI-only, and `-v 4` for verbose output, and the GitHub README claims "extensive command line tools for increased simulation introspection and control." Nothing in the evidence shows AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or a full command reference, so the story's agentic angle is unproven; the probes show no llms.txt or markdown docs. missing for 10: documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) CLI output, a complete documented reference of the introspection/control subcommands, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agentic workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
